newsitem.title: JAPAN: RTRS-Dlr expected to be capped above 115 yen in Asia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Dlr expected to be capped above 115 yen in Asia.

text.p: The dollar is likely to be capped just above 115 yen in Asia on Thursday due to possible sales by exporters and hedge-related sales by Japanese institutional investors, dealers said. "There are large selling orders lined up above 115 yen," a Japanese commercial bank dealer said. "But commercial demand should keep the dollar well-supported in the morning." The dollar's firmness against the mark is expected to persist after a broke through a key technical resistance of 1.75 marks overnight, but the market lacks a strong driving force to move it sharply above the previous high of 1.7550 In New York, the dollar pushed to another 40-month peak against the mark but fell sharply against a surging pound after Britain's Labour government unveiled its first budget.

The pound surged to a high of $1.6785 in New York before settling at $1.6765/75. It also ended U.S. trade at a new five-year peak of 2.9430 marks, helping the dollar post gains against the mark as well.
Dealers in Tokyo said the pound would likely retain its underlying strength but they did not expect it to extend its gains during Asian trading time.
